title: Akiyama Mizuki — Don't Be Scared〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whew! That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I had fun too...!
Whizzing around on those rides was so amazing.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I agree. I was a bit startled, but we also got to see some beautiful sights.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm glad you guys liked it, but I could really go for a quick break now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm going to get something to drink...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, go for it♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena, Kanade, there's a nice bench just over there, so let's wait for Mafuyu there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure, sounds good...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You two, okay?
Was that roller coaster a bit too much?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, it's not that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But I hadn't gone on it such a long time...
I kept asking myself, “Was this thing always so scary?”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! To be fair, it got a bit of a facelift to make it more thrilling than before!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: While we screamed our lungs out, Mafuyu just sat there like nothing was happening.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, not knowing what she's thinking is sort of par for the course, but I feel like she's been spacing out a lot today, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree... Could it be that skipping her practice exam is bothering her more than we realize?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But she came all this way to join us, so I really want her to have some fun at least...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, where is she...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? It hasn't been that long, but maybe she's waiting in line to make her purchase.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Waiting in line...? I see two or three people tops... There, look...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hm? Whoa, you're right!
The shop's literally right there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
So, Mafuyu's...
Not in line there it seems.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, I remember now!
I think she went off in the other direction...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? Seriously, where's her head at today...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But for now, let's just give her a little more time and be patient. I'm sure Miku and Len are with her too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Are you worried about her, Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Today's one thing, but she was also acting a bit strange the last time we spoke in SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Her mom found out that she saved that synthesizer and was still using it, which probably led to a really unpleasant conversation...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And when we met up with her today...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (The way she said, “I don't know...” She seems totally conflicted and unable to think clearly.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I know Miku and Len are with her, but given her current state, maybe it isn't such a good idea to leave her alone right now.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, I'm gonna try looking for Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, you're gonna look for her...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll be fine. I just have to call her and ask about her general surroundings...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hm? I just got a message...
Oh, it's from Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really?! What'd she say?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She said... <I think I'm lost.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're kidding, right?
She's a high-schooler, not some little kid...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Let's cut her some slack for now.
Kanade, mind telling her to just stay put? Also, can you ask about what she sees around her?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, will do.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Ugh...
Alright, let's find her together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's great and all, but are you two sure you don't want to rest for a bit longer?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm okay now, Mizuki, but I appreciate the thought.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Same. If anything, waiting around is starting to make my blood boil.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, Mafuyu just replied...
So, it sounds like she's close to Phenny's shop.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I think I remember seeing it while we made our way towards the roller coaster!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, Mafuyu's waiting for us, so let's get a move on!

rows.Speaker: Ena & Kanade
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (There probably isn't a whole lot I can do, but I wanna do what I can for Mafuyu...)
